$comment: When each part of the content-source contract's surface arrived, and the oldest version a host still runs. Only what changed: anything absent has been there since version 1. See contracts/README.md for what reads it and why it carries no names of its own. Version 10's `multi` configSchema field type was withdrawn (kangzj/lantern-tv#440) and is no longer listed; the version number itself stands. Version 21 removed `lantern`, the host global's old name, so only `yonto` is left, and no host runs a plugin declaring anything older: that is `oldest`. Version 19's entry for naming `yonto` went with it, since every plugin now does.
